stem: Jatin must write $84152607$ with commas in the Indian system and then read it.

parts.text: Which claim correctly finishes both steps?

options.text: Write $8,41,52,607$ and read eight crore forty-one lakh fifty-two thousand six hundred seven.
Place commas in threes as $84,152,607$ and read it with million as the Indian reading.
Write $8,41,52,607$ with no reading in words, and treat the commas alone as finishing the task.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Indian grouping is 3-2-2 from the right, giving 8,41,52,607, read with crore and lakh.

teacher.key_rationale: Indian commas group 3-2-2: 8,41,52,607, read with crore/lakh. American threes+million swaps systems. Commas without the reading omit the full task.
